candidates.spoken: An earthquake shook the dam holding Los Angeles' water.
The dam was built with hydraulic fill.
The Lower Van Norman Dam nearly failed in the San Fernando earthquake.
Luckily, the reservoir was only about half full.
Eighty thousand people were evacuated for three days.
It took only earthquake shaking liquefying the dam's fill.
It started with hydraulic fill dam. It ended with emergency drawdown.
After Van Norman Dam, seismic safety of embankment dams was transformed.
Engineers lowered the water as fast as possible.
It transformed the seismic safety of earthen dams.
The reservoir happened to be only half full.
Within seconds, part of its crest slid into the reservoir.
Van Norman Dam: what failed first?

script.spoken: The dam didn't fail. Within seconds, part of its crest slid into the reservoir. The dam was built with hydraulic fill. Shaking made the fill liquefy. Luckily, the reservoir was only about half full. Eighty thousand people were evacuated for three days. Engineers lowered the water as fast as possible. It transformed the seismic safety of earthen dams.
